comparison.objective: Mount a phone in a sprung car holder so its arms grip the phone; candidate sets and locks the maximum opening of an industrial gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Across versions, either cock-and-trigger or continuously hold open paired clamp arms while positioning a phone; candidate uses concentric tools and countertorque on threaded hardware.
comparison.success_condition: Phone seated and edge-clamped, released and still for one second, with drop and face-clamping failures; candidate requires angle tolerance, nut retention, three cycles, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Manipulating a spring clamp around an inserted phone does not test preserving an adjustable screw position while tightening its jam nut.
